description: Content library for the Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali agent. RULE (owner-set, 2026-09-22): the caption language MUST match the language of the scripture on the image — English image -> English caption, Swahili image -> Swahili caption ('lang' field on every entry). The agent alternates daily: one day English, the next Swahili. English images: YouVersion Verse of the Day + web verse graphics. Swahili images: YouVersion 'Fungu la Siku' (Swahili VOTD, collected from bible.com/sw/verse-of-the-day); their verse text is quoted verbatim as written on each image (BHN/SUV wording, verified against bible.com). Captions: verse + two sentences of explanation and encouragement + five hashtags ending with #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali. With a GEMINI_API_KEY secret configured, the agent re-writes the Swahili encouragement sentences with Google Gemini at posting time (stored caption = fallback).

posts.source: YouVersion Verse of the Day, 15 Sep 2026
posts.caption:
Lamentations 3:22

"The faithful love of the LORD never ends! His mercies never cease."

Every new morning is quiet proof that God's mercy has not run out on you. Whatever yesterday held, His compassion meets you fresh today — great is His faithfulness.

#Lamentations #MercyOfGod #FaithfulLove #NewMercies #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Verse of the Day, 16 Sep 2026
posts.caption:
Isaiah 41:13

"Fear not, for I am the one who helps you."

The God who formed you does not shout this from a distance — He holds your right hand as He says it. Whatever fear you carry today, put it down; your Helper is already beside you.

#Isaiah #FearNot #GodIsMyHelper #FaithOverFear #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Verse of the Day, 17 Sep 2026
posts.caption:
Romans 8:6

"The mind governed by the flesh is death, but the mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace."

Peace is not produced by perfect circumstances but by a mind surrendered to God's Spirit. Feed your thoughts with His Word today, and watch life and calm follow.

#Romans #MindOfTheSpirit #LifeAndPeace #WalkByTheSpirit #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.caption:
Proverbs 3:7

"Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and shun evil."

True wisdom begins with humility — admitting we do not see everything. When you honor God first, He keeps your feet on a clean and steady path.

#Proverbs #Wisdom #FearOfTheLord #Humility #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.caption:

#Philippians #Gratitude #ThankfulHeart #ThankGod #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Verse of the Day, 20 Sep 2026
posts.caption:
Psalm 9:1

"I will give thanks to you, LORD, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds."

Praise flows naturally from a heart that remembers what God has done. Count His faithfulness from your past days, and let your mouth tell of it today.

#Psalm #Praise #Thanksgiving #WonderfulDeeds #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

#Deuteronomy #FaithfulGod #Covenant #Generations #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: Verse graphic (web), Jeremiah 29:11

"For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future."

Even in unfamiliar seasons, God's plans for you have never left His hands. Your story does not end in the waiting — it ends in hope.

#Jeremiah #Hope #Future #GodsPlan #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: Verse graphic (web), James 1:2-4 (NKJV)
posts.caption:
James 1:2-4

"Count it all joy when you fall into various trials, knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience. But let patience have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing."

Trials are not sent to break your faith but to strengthen it into something durable. Don't give up — every test you pass brings you one step closer to completeness.

#James #Trials #Patience #Faith #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

1 Peter 4:8

"Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins."

Real love is a daily choice to extend the same mercy Christ showed us. Where love is genuine, many offenses lose their power to divide.

"For the king trusts in the LORD; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken."

Those who trust in the LORD stand unshaken even when everything else trembles. His unfailing love is a pillar stronger than any fortress.

#Psalm #Trust #UnfailingLove #Unshaken #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Fungu la Siku, 16 Sep 2026 (Kiswahili)
posts.caption:

"Usiogope, nitakusaidia."

Maneno haya BWANA mwenyewe anayatamka kwako — si ahadi ya mbali, bali ya karibu mno. Kama hofu inakufinya leo, jua kwamba Yeye aliyekuumba yu pembeni yako, tayari kushika mkono wako na kukusaidia.

#Isaya #Usiogope #MunguMsaidizi #Imani #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Fungu la Siku, 17 Sep 2026 (Kiswahili)
posts.caption:
Warumi 8:6

"Kwa kuwa nia ya mwili ni mauti; bali nia ya roho ni uzima na amani."

Amani ya kweli haitokani na mazingira, bali na nia inayomruhusu Roho wa Mungu kuiongoza. Leo, lishughulikie moyo wako kwa Neno lake, na uzima na amani vitakufunika.

#Warumi #AmaniYaMungu #RohoWaMungu #Uzima #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Fungu la Siku, 18 Sep 2026 (Kiswahili)
posts.caption:
Mithali 3:7

"Usiwe na hekima machoni pako mwenyewe; Mche BWANA, ukajiepushe na uovu."

Hekima ya kweli huanza kwa kumcha Mungu, si kwa kujiamini ufahamu wetu wenyewe. Unapoinama mbele yake, Yeye anakuelekeza njia safi na kukuepusha na mitego ya uovu.

#Mithali #Hekima #KumchaMungu #NjiaSafi #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Fungu la Siku, 19 Sep 2026 (Kiswahili)
posts.caption:
Wafilipi 1:3

"Namshukuru Mungu wangu kila ninapowakumbukeni."

Shukrani ni dalili ya moyo unaotambua wema wa Mungu unaofika kwa watu walio maishani mwetu. Fanya leo kuwa siku ya kumshukuru Mungu kwa kila mtu aliyekuweka njiani — utaona baraka nyingi za kuzishukuru.

#Wafilipi #Shukrani #MoyoWaShukrani #Baraka #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Fungu la Siku, 20 Sep 2026 (Kiswahili)
posts.caption:

"Nitakushukuru Mungu kwa moyo wangu wote; nitayasimulia matendo yake yote ya ajabu."

Kumtukuza Mungu kwa moyo wote hutoka kwa kumbukumbu ya ajabu zake alizotenda kwetu. Kumbuka mara moja moja matendo yake mema, na asubuhi hii mpe sifa anayostahili.

#Zaburi #Sifa #KumshukuruMungu #MatendoYaAjabu #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Fungu la Siku, 21 Sep 2026 (Kiswahili)
posts.caption:
Kumbukumbu la Sheria 7:9

"Basi, jueni kwamba Mwenyezi-Mungu, Mungu wenu, ndiye Mungu; ni Mungu mwaminifu, anayeshika agano lake na huwaonesha fadhili kwa vizazi vingi vya wale wanaoshika amri zake."

Katika ulimwengu wa ahadi zinazovunjika, Mungu ndiye pekee anayeshika agano lake kwa maelfu ya vizazi. Weka matumaini yako kwake; uaminifu wake hauishi na wakati.

#Uaminifu #AganoLaMungu #MunguMwaminifu #Matumaini #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

posts.source: YouVersion Fungu la Siku, 22 Sep 2026 (Kiswahili, design A)
posts.caption:
Wagalatia 1:10

"Sasa nataka kibali cha nani: Cha binadamu, ama cha Mungu? Au je, nataka kuwapendeza watu? Kama ningefanya hivyo, mimi singekuwa kamwe mtumishi wa Kristo."

Swali la Paulo linagusa kila moyo: tunatafuta kibali cha nani — cha watu au cha Mungu? Chagua leo kumpendeza Mungu kuliko watu, na utaishi huru moyoni.

#Wagalatia #KibaliChaMungu #UhuruWaMoyo #Utumishi #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali
